channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2024-10441 — Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM)
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

item.title: CVE-2018-8581 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 80. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Microsoft Exchange Server. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could attempt to impersonate any other user of the Exchange server.

item.title: CVE-2026-20963 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-20045 — Cisco Unified Communications Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Cisco Unified Communications Manager (Unified CM), Cisco Unified Communications Manager Session Management Edition (Unified CM SME), Cisco Unified Communications Manager IM & Presence Service (Unified CM IM&P), Cisco Unity Connection, and Cisco Webex Calling Dedicated Instance contain a code injection vulnerability that could allow the attacker to obtain user-level access to the underlying operating system and then elevate privileges to root.

item.title: CVE-2025-68461 — Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 69. RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via the animate tag in an SVG document.

item.title: CVE-2026-129448 — Apache Roller
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.

item.title: CVE-2020-10181 — Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR)
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR) contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability allowing the creation of users with elevated privileges as administrator on a device.

item.title: CVE-2026-32201 — Microsoft SharePoint Server
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Microsoft SharePoint Server contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

item.title: CVE-2020-8195 — Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Citrix ADC, Citrix Gateway, and multiple Citrix SD-WAN WANOP appliance models contain an information disclosure vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2019-7193 — QNAP QTS
item.description: Threat Signal 79. QNAP QTS contains an improper input validation vulnerability allowing remote attackers to inject code on the system.

item.title: CVE-2026-124194 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

item.title: CVE-2024-20353 — Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) contain an infinite loop vulnerability that can lead to remote denial of service condition.

item.title: CVE-2021-22893 — Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute code via license services.

item.title: CVE-2013-4810 — Hewlett Packard (HP) ProCurve Manager (PCM), PCM+, Identity Driven Manager (IDM), and Application Lifecycle Management
item.description: Threat Signal 80. HP ProCurve Manager (PCM), PCM+, Identity Driven Manager (IDM), and Application Lifecycle Management allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a marshalled object to (1) EJBInvokerServlet or (2) JMXInvokerServlet.

item.title: CVE-2020-8196 — Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Citrix ADC, Citrix Gateway, and multiple Citrix SD-WAN WANOP appliance models contain an information disclosure vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2026-50522 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which could allow an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-20131 — Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC)
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the web-based management interface that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary Java code as root on an affected device.

item.title: CVE-2026-115731 — Perforce Puppet Enterprise
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request. If the certificate authority automatically signs requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain a valid certificate and exploit the vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2016-20017 — D-Link DSL-2750B Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 77. D-Link DSL-2750B devices contain a command injection vulnerability that allows remote, unauthenticated command injection via the login.cgi cli parameter.

item.title: CVE-2026-59310 — Broadcom VMware vCenter
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2019-19356 — Netis WF2419 Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Netis WF2419 devices contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution as root through the router's web management page.

item.title: CVE-2023-36845 — Juniper Junos OS
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Juniper Junos OS on EX Series and SRX Series contains a PHP external variable modification vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to control an important environment variable. Using a crafted request, which sets the variable PHPRC, an attacker is able to modify the PHP execution environment allowing the injection und execution of code.

item.title: CVE-2010-1871 — Red Hat JBoss Seam 2
item.description: Threat Signal 77. JBoss Seam 2 (jboss-seam2), as used in JBoss Enterprise Application Platform 4.3.0 for Red Hat Linux, allows attackers to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability can only be exploited when the Java Security Manager is not properly configured.

item.title: CVE-2020-8193 — Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Citrix ADC, Citrix Gateway, and multiple Citrix SD-WAN WANOP appliance models contain an authorization bypass vulnerability that may allow unauthenticated access to certain URL endpoints. The attacker must have access to the NetScaler IP (NSIP) in order to perform exploitation.

item.title: CVE-2016-11021 — D-Link DCS-930L Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 70. setSystemCommand on D-Link DCS-930L devices allows a remote attacker to execute code via an OS command.

item.title: CVE-2020-8218 — Pulse Secure Pulse Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A code injection vulnerability exists in Pulse Connect Secure that allows an attacker to crafted a URI to perform an arbitrary code execution via the admin web interface.

item.title: CVE-2020-8644 — PlaySMS PlaySMS
item.description: Threat Signal 78. PlaySMS contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-17463 — Fuel CMS Fuel CMS
item.description: Threat Signal 79. FUEL CMS 1.4.7 allows SQL Injection via the col parameter to /pages/items, /permissions/items, or /navigation/items.

item.title: CVE-2023-24880 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Microsoft Windows SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to evade Mark of the Web (MOTW) defenses via a specially crafted malicious file.

item.title: CVE-2025-42884 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 63. SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

item.title: CVE-2019-7194 — QNAP Photo Station
item.description: Threat Signal 89. QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

item.title: CVE-2026-123890 — Broadcom VMware vCenter
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

item.title: CVE-2013-3896 — Microsoft Silverlight
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Silverlight does not properly validate pointers during access to Silverlight elements, which allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information via a crafted Silverlight application.

item.title: CVE-2025-20352 — Cisco IOS and IOS XE
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Cisco IOS and IOS XE contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem that could allow for denial of service or remote code execution. A successful exploit could allow a low-privileged attacker to cause the affected system to reload, resulting in a DoS condition, or allow a high-privileged attacker to execute arbitrary code as the root user and obtain full control of the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2023-26360 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-76466 — Cisco Expressway Series
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

item.title: CVE-2025-24085 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Apple iOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain a user-after-free vulnerability that could allow a malicious application to elevate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-40217 — BerriAI LiteLLM
item.description: Threat Signal 82. BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.

item.title: CVE-2019-7195 — QNAP Photo Station
item.description: Threat Signal 89. QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

item.title: CVE-2019-7192 — QNAP Photo Station
item.description: Threat Signal 89. QNAP NAS devices running Photo Station contain an improper access control vulnerability allowing remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the system.
